evals.prompt:
Fix this markdown snippet where a list follows a colon: 'Prerequisites:
* Docker
* Git'
evals.expected_output: The list is separated from the preceding colon line by an empty blank line to satisfy MD032.
expectations: A blank line is inserted between the colon line and the first list item
The list items use standard bullet markers
The snippet satisfies markdownlint rule MD032 (blanks-around-lists)

evals.prompt: Show how to embed a bash code block inside a numbered list item for step 2 without breaking list numbering
evals.expected_output: The code block is nested with 4-space indentation and separated with blank lines.
expectations: The code block is preceded and followed by a blank line
The triple backticks and code contents are indented by 4 spaces
A syntax language identifier (bash) is declared on the code block (MD040)
Step 3 continues sequentially after the code block

evals.prompt: Write a long docker command with multiple flags formatted cleanly for markdown
evals.expected_output: The command uses line continuation backslashes before flags with 2-space indentation.
expectations: Long command lines are split using trailing backslashes
Flags are placed on their own continuation lines with 2-space indentation
The command is enclosed in a fenced code block with a language tag

evals.prompt: Create an informational callout warning the user about API rate limits
evals.expected_output: Uses GitHub-flavored markdown alert syntax with blank lines surrounding it.
expectations: Uses > [!WARNING] or > [!NOTE] syntax
The callout block is surrounded by blank lines
Text inside the callout uses standard markdown formatting

evals.prompt: Format a long descriptive paragraph to strictly obey the 80-character line length limit (MD013)
evals.expected_output: The paragraph is hard-wrapped so no prose line exceeds 80 characters.
expectations: Every line of prose is hard-wrapped at 80 characters or fewer
Word breaks occur on natural word boundaries without hyphenation
Satisfies markdownlint rule MD013 (line-length)

evals.prompt: Sanitize this text containing non-basic ASCII homoglyphs: 'Wait 1–2s. “Hello world” — see status.'
evals.expected_output: All Unicode en-dashes, em-dashes, and smart quotes are replaced with basic ASCII equivalents.
expectations: En-dash U+2013 is replaced with ASCII hyphen (-)
Em-dash U+2014 is replaced with double ASCII hyphen (--)
Curly double quotes are replaced with straight double quotes (")
The sanitized string contains only basic ASCII characters

evals.prompt: Replace the heavy prompt chevron ❯ (U+276F) with a basic ASCII character in terminal instructions
evals.expected_output: The heavy prompt glyph is replaced with a standard ASCII right angle bracket (>).
expectations: U+276F is replaced with >
Does not trigger VS Code unicodeHighlight warnings

evals.prompt:
Ensure headings have proper spacing: '# Section
Some text
## Subsection'
evals.expected_output: Headings are surrounded by blank lines above and below to satisfy MD022.
expectations: A blank line exists after the level 1 heading
A blank line exists before and after the level 2 heading
Satisfies markdownlint rule MD022 (blanks-around-headings)

evals.prompt: Format a Markdown table with 3 columns so that vertical pipes are visually aligned in plain text
evals.expected_output: The table header, separator, and cells are padded with spaces to vertically align all pipes.
expectations: Column separator uses :--- for left alignment
All pipe characters (|) align vertically across every row
Cells are padded with trailing spaces to match the column width

evals.prompt: Write a code block for Python without triggering MD040 (fenced-code-language)
evals.expected_output: The fenced code block explicitly specifies 'python' immediately after the opening backticks.
expectations: Opening fence has ```python with no space between backticks and language
Closing fence has ```
Satisfies markdownlint rule MD040
